description: [0.010000 USDC via x402] Resolves any US public equity ticker (including class shares like BRK.B / BRK/B), 10-digit CIK, company name, or multi-issuer theme against SEC EDGAR submissions and 90-day EFTS full-text index to extract deduplicated Form 4 insider filings, decoded Form 8-K item catalysts, and activity band.

limit.description: Maximum recent Form 4 and Form 8-K filings to return (1 to 25, default 8).

query.description: Stock ticker (e.g., 'NVDA', 'AAPL', 'BRK/B', 'COIN'), 10-digit CIK, company name, or multi-issuer theme ('Crypto', 'Quantum', 'AI chip').

name: fetch_sec_insider_and_8k
